item.title: Hegseth reveals covert visit to troops fighting in Operation Epic Fury
item.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth opened a Pentagon news conference Tuesday detailing a covert visit to troops fighting in Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Sharks in Bahamas found to have cocaine and other drugs in their systems, study says
item.summary: A new study found cocaine, caffeine and painkillers in 28 Bahamas sharks, with researchers saying tourists may be the likely source of the contamination.

item.title: Scoop: House Speaker Mike Johnson's allies unleash $10M campaign to spotlight Trump tax cuts
item.summary: The American Action Network says it's launching a $10 million ad blitz through Tax Day to promote the Working Families Tax Cuts Act across 37 congressional districts.

item.title: Browns owner gives optimistic outlook for injury-riddled Deshaun Watson
item.summary: Cleveland Browns team owner Jimmy Haslam expressed a sunny outlook for quarterback Deshaun Watson despite his injury-riddled tenure with the team.

item.title: Trump's proposed presidential library revealed as towering Miami skyscraper in striking new video
item.summary: New renderings of President Donald Trump's proposed Miami presidential library reveal a glass waterfront skyscraper with gold lettering, a Trump statue and Oval Office replicas.

item.title: First of its kind wagon evidence uncovered in massive Iron Age treasure trove
item.summary: Researchers say 950 Iron Age metal objects near Melsonby, Yorkshire, may be the first evidence of four-wheeled wagons ever found in Britain. The findings were just published.

item.title: NFL quarterback Chris Streveler retires at 31
item.summary: Chris Streveler, who played in the NFL for the Arizona Cardinals and New York Jets during his career, announced he was retiring from the league at age 31.

item.title: Nancy Grace says Guthrie disappearance reopens wounds from fiancé's 1979 murder
item.summary: Nancy Grace says Savannah Guthrie's mother's disappearance brought back grief over her fiancé Keith Griffin's 1979 murder, just months before their wedding.

item.title: Patriots star appears to show support for ex-Bulls player after rant against NBA's Pride Month celebration
item.summary: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson appeared to show support for former Chicago Bulls player Jaden Ivey after the guard ranted against support of Pride Month.
